description: Cited voyage legs for the NABOU//X 3D voyage view. Coordinates are never stored here: every endpoint is a gazetteer_id from data/gazetteer/mediterranean_gazetteer.v1.json. A leg is shown and animated only when review_status is USER_APPROVED (approved by the historian). Lines between ports are SCHEMATIC, not the real course.

rules.endpoints: from/to must carry a gazetteer_id present in data/gazetteer/mediterranean_gazetteer.v1.json and the name as written in the source
rules.citation: every leg needs run_id, claim_ids and a citation with title, page, url and verbatim quote; the source must state a movement from A to B
rules.date: date_in_source, when given, must appear verbatim in the quote
rules.certainty: STATED = solid line (the source says it explicitly); UNCERTAIN = dashed line
rules.review_status: PENDING_REVIEW legs are never drawn; only USER_APPROVED legs are drawn and animated
rules.geometry: SCHEMATIC only; waypoints are cartographic aids (cartographic_aid: true), never historical claims
rules.gaps: never fill missing legs; two places mentioned one after the other are not joined
